note: Economy difficulty. These multipliers change the PLAYER's operating position only; NPC carriers, prices and the rest of the world run on the base economy at every level, so a harder level means a harder life for you, not a different universe. target_margin is the net margin the benchmark ship (the starter) should earn on the reference lane mix; tests/test_economy_levels.gd checks each level lands inside its band, and tools like it retune the multipliers when the economy changes. Multipliers were solved with tests/solve_levels.gd (bisect freight_pay_mult against target margin); rerun it whenever base rates, fuel, ship costs or the starter ship change.

benchmark.note: Share of time the ship has paid cargo, and the share of return legs that also carry paid cargo.

difficulty_ids_match: Level ids match Worlds.DIFFICULTIES ids, so the difficulty chosen at New Game selects the economy level.
